answer.evidence: radon/metrics.py defines HalsteadReport (h1 h2 N1 N2 vocabulary length calculated_length volume difficulty effort time bugs) and halstead_visitor_report(), which computes them. It guards zero counts: volume = N*log2(h) if h != 0 else 0; difficulty = (h1*N2)/float(2*h2) if h2 != 0 else 0; effort = difficulty*volume; time = effort/18.0; bugs = volume/3000.0. The docstring in h_visit_ast documents the formulas. mi_compute also guards volume<=0. radon/visitors.py (HalsteadVisitor) only collects the operator and operand counts, so it is secondary. raw.py and complexity.py have no Halstead formulas, since grep found none there.
